brief:
The West Bank recorded 852 violations committed by Israeli occupation forces and settlers during the week of August 7–13, according to monitoring by the centre tracked by Shehab Wire. The incidents marked an escalation affecting Palestinian civilians and their communities across the territory.

The violations targeted Palestinians directly, along with their property, agricultural land, and religious sites. The documented incidents occurred amid ongoing tensions in the occupied West Bank.
